summary: A8 rule v1.4 (contract section 24): a player whose thread was cut and who gets home before the spark now SURVIVES but CAPTURES NOTHING, and the pending lasso pocket of that exit is erased. CORE (EventResolver step a): a returner that has a spark at the return instant gets Array.Empty<int>() as its capture set (CaptureSolver is not called), so it claims no cell in the R18 conflict rule; its trail, spark and pocket are cleared (the pocket is never validated), Home = true, and its Return event keeps Chased = true and Margin as before with Cells = an empty array (D2 keeps it out of Captures). Unchased returns are byte for byte unchanged. Code path review: StepReturns is the only place in Core that applies a capture (ComputeCapture is its only CaptureSolver caller; Eliminate only neutralizes), so the same branch covers simultaneous returns (a chased returner contests nothing, so the overlap goes to the other returner), a return in the TimeUp group (the audit R19 tie test), a return whose cell is taken at the same instant by another returner (it is saved, then TerritoryStolen + Exit restart a spark-less exit), DebugForceCut states (chased, capture empty) and DebugSetTrail (clears spark and pocket, never chased). CaughtBeforeReturn (return strictly after the catch candidate) and R14 (a cut at the closure instant is dropped, so that return is unchased and captures) are unchanged. TESTS: S2 rewritten per section 24 at 30/60/144 Hz under the 10.0 protocol (saved, Chased, Margin > 0 and equal to (L - S) / SparkSpeed, Return.Cells empty, Captures 0, every grid cell identical to the start, A's count checked after every tick; the uncut control still captures more than 3000 cells). R13b (Rules and Audit) also assert empty Cells and unchanged territory. New R13c (cross-rate: charged lasso pocket at t = 3.5 holding a rival cell, a real cut near the trail origin at t = 4.25 by a scripted third player, saved return with a 1.5 s margin: pocket erased, PocketsMade 1, Captures 0, A, B and C cell counts unchanged, rival cell kept, pocket interior and ordinary region neutral) and R13d (same scenario, the cutter circles at home: the unchased return validates the pocket and captures the ordinary area). New R18b_ChasedReturnerClaimsNoCellAndStillRestartsAnExitWhenItsCellIsTaken. Existing tests that expected a chased return to capture (exactly the two that failed after the core change, out of 274): ScenarioTests.S2 (renamed S2_CutNearTheOriginVictimWinsTheRaceSurvivesAndCapturesNothing) and AuditTests.R19_ReturnAndImpactBothExactlyAtRoundDurationTheReturnWinsAndCounts (FinalCells > 6144 became FinalCells == 6144 with empty Cells; ranks 1, 2 unchanged because the saved player is ranked alive). Strengthened with section 24 assertions (they already passed): R17b_LassoDuringAChaseLeavesTheSparkUnchanged, Bots_OwnSparkTriggersTheReturnAfterReactionDelay, the roaming fuzz deep invariants (every chased Return has no cells) and the bot-only rounds (ChasedReturns / ChasedCaptures tracked; 0 chased captures asserted in dotnet and Unity, > 0 saved returns asserted in dotnet). BOTS: TryAttack now prefers a lethal sample (probability AttackChance, unchanged), otherwise makes a DENIAL cut on the largest reachable exposed s_k when the victim's trail is >= DenialMinTrail = 6 u, with probability AttackChance x 0.6 (Aggressive x 1.0), x HumanAttackScale for the human, drawn once per enemy exit; same commit (1.5 s, re-aim at the same s_k) and abort rules. It replaces the v1.3 Aggressive-only harassment cut (AttackChance / 3). A chased bot still goes straight home (unchanged). Bots_HarassmentCutsAreAggressiveOnly is replaced by Bots_DenialCutsNeedASixUnitTrailWhenNoSampleIsLethal (4 styles attack a non-lethal sample on a 6 u trail, nobody on a 4 u trail, the aim is the most recent exposed sample) and Bots_DenialDrawProbabilityIsAttackChanceTimesTheStyleScale (300 seeds: Balanced 0.5 -> 90/300, Greedy 1.0 -> 170/300, Aggressive 0.5 -> 136/300, expected 0.3 / 0.6 / 0.5). RETUNE: with the denial cut the asserted Spark-elimination share reached 86 % (lasso on and off, target 35-85 %). AttackChance, AttackRadius, ReactionDelay, SenseRadius and trail-length changes stayed at 80-92 % (most kills come from incidental cuts on long trails); ThreatRadius was the effective lever. Final: Greedy ThreatRadius 4.5 -> 8 and Aggressive 5 -> 8 (Balanced unchanged, so the human-proxy fixture built from Balanced keeps its value), chosen on seeds 1-50 and checked on held-out seeds 51-150. BOT STATISTICS (50 seeds, dotnet, all asserted targets met): lasso on: captures per bot 24.66 / 24.92 / 21.78 / 31.80, cuts in 92 % of matches, Spark elimination in 70 %, TimeUp 98 %, mean coverage 41.5 %, 45 Spark eliminations (escapable 0 %), 0 held ticks, 134 cuts (44 deliberate from 324 attack starts), 88 saved chased returns with 0 cells; lasso off: 24.54 / 24.70 / 21.72 / 29.86, cuts 98 %, Spark 74 %, TimeUp 98 %, coverage 41.5 %, 48 Spark eliminations, 108 saved returns with 0 cells. Held-out seeds 51-150: lasso on cuts 95 % / Spark 67 % / coverage 41.0 %, lasso off 95 % / 70 % / 39.0 %. Before the retune (denial cut, v1.3 presets): lasso on 96 % / 86 % / TimeUp 94 % / 36.7 %, lasso off 100 % / 86 % / 94 % / 35.4 %. Rule change alone (no denial cut): 88 % / 72 % and 92 % / 70 %. A7 baseline (v1.3): 88 % / 68 % and 92 % / 72 %. Reported only: trailing share 64-74 % (target 30-75 %); human-proxy fixture alive at the end 76 % lasso on (target 35-75 %, one round over) / 66 % lasso off, first 18 % / 18 % (target 15-45 %). RESULTS: dotnet full run (--artifacts-path tools/CoreTests/.art/A8): 284 executed, 284 passed, 0 failed (274 before: +12 new cases, -2 replaced harassment cases); the 2 explicit BotReport cases pass when run separately (286/286). EventCapHits == 0 is asserted after every tick of every rule, scenario, audit and bot run. Unity EditMode through tools/unity.ps1 -Agent A8: JUnit tests=367 failures=4 errors=0 skipped=2 (TestResults/A8_edit.xml). All 285 Core tests pass (283 executed + the 2 explicit BotReport skips). The 4 failures are Runtime tests that replay DemoScenario (owned by B0a / B1 / B5, not editable by A8) and fail only because the demo's first return is a saved chase that now captures nothing (contract 24): DemoScenarioTests.Demo_HeadlessRunHasTheExpectedEventsAndCheckpoints, DemoScenarioTests.Demo_AsAGameSessionMatchesTheHeadlessRunAtTwoDisplayCadences, LiquidRenderTests.B1_FillWave_DistanceOrderThenEqualsGrid, SfxTests.Sfx_DemoRoundPlaysTheHumanCuesAndHapticsInOrder. The Unity run is therefore not fully green until the DemoScenario owner rebuilds the demo for v1.4 (see needs).

contract_issues: Section 9 reading: the section 24 attack rule is applied as a full replacement of the v1.3 'only Aggressive bots attack a non-lethal sample with probability AttackChance / 3' (harassment). As with the v1.3 harassment draw, a victim whose lethal draw failed can get its denial draw at a later decision (lethal and denial are drawn once each per enemy exit), so a Balanced bot attacks a lethal-eligible victim with overall probability 0.45 + 0.55 x 0.27 = 0.60 when its trail is >= 6 u.
Sections 5.7 and 23.1 still list the v1.3 presets: Greedy and Aggressive ThreatRadius are now 8 (A8 retune, the only change). Please update the table at the next contract revision.
